title: What is AI?
intro: Hi, I'm SI, a dragon robot and a computer program. Let's find out what AI is!
AI (artificial intelligence) is a computer program that learns patterns from lots and lots of examples. Then it uses those patterns to guess answers, recognise pictures or write text.
AI doesn't think or feel like a person. It is a very fast pattern-finder, and it can be wrong.

game.prompt: Sort each thing: does it use AI or not?

items.text: A phone that unlocks when it recognises your face
items.explain: The phone learned what your face looks like from many pictures. That's AI.

items.text: A switch that turns on the lamp
items.explain: The switch just closes an electric circuit. It doesn't learn anything.

items.text: A video app that suggests what to watch next
items.explain: It learns from what you watched before and guesses what you'll like.
A calculator follows fixed rules. It doesn't learn from examples.
A chatbot learned how to write answers from millions of texts. That's AI.

items.text: A doorbell that rings when you press it
items.explain: The doorbell always does the same thing. There's no learning in it.

quiz.question: How does AI learn?
options: It knows everything from the start
quiz.explain: AI finds patterns in lots of examples.

quiz.question: Can AI make mistakes?
quiz.explain: AI guesses from patterns, and sometimes the guess is wrong. It's always worth checking.

quiz.question: Which one is true about AI?
options: It feels happy and sad like people
It is a computer program that finds patterns
A real person lives inside the computer
quiz.explain: AI is a program. It has no feelings, even when it writes like a person.

summary: AI is a computer program that learns patterns from examples. It is useful, but it can be wrong, and it is not a person.
